message: The other night, I was making dinner when I suddenly heard the smoke alarm doing its best impression of a siren. Turns out I had let the pasta boil over—classic rookie move! Amidst the chaos, my family group chat exploded with messages: "Is the house on fire?" followed by a ton of laughing emojis. It reminded me how important it is to have an escape plan and to keep those smoke alarms in check. Have you ever had a funny kitchen mishap like that? What’s your go-to fire safety tip?
